shared_elements: upright slab/stele surface with decoration confined to a defined field
horizontal band or division across the upper part of the surface
elongated curving animal-like forms in low relief/outline
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both are upright slabs whose upper zone is set off by a horizontal band, and both include elongated curving creature forms rendered in outline/low relief. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A is a symmetrical, densely ornamental composition of spirals, interlace and a central interlaced roundel with serpentine heads, while B shows recognisable quadrupeds in profile stacked on a plain field with no ornamental infill or central medallion.
